Exchanges.Text:
Good morning, Payments (Demo) team.

Sprint goal: Customers can pay by card and failed payments retry automatically. There are 6 days left in the sprint.
Daniel, is story 3 done, is story 4 done, and is task 15 done? If not, please say what you finished, what you’re doing next, and whether anything is blocking you.
Yesterday I finished card tokenisation and shipped the payment status API version two. Today I'm adding idempotency keys to payment requests. Nothing blocking me.

Daniel, I’ve noted your commitment: yesterday you finished card tokenisation and shipped the payment status API version two, and today you’re adding idempotency keys to payment requests, with nothing blocking you.

story 3, Customer payment plan summary page, has been Active for 4 days. Still on track?
Yes, it's on track. I'll pick the summary page back up as soon as the idempotency keys are in.
Who can help unblock the summary page work by getting the idempotency keys in?
Yes, that's right. That's everything from me.
Daniel, task 15, Add structured logging to gateway client, has been Active for 4 days. Still on track?
Structured logging is nearly done. I'll finish it today.

Thanks, Daniel.
Maya, is story 5 done and is bug 12 done, and what did you finish, what’s next, and is anything blocking you?

Yesterday I reviewed the settlement schema. Today I'm continuing the settlement file validation. I'm blocked on bug 12. The sandbox gateway keeps timing out, and I need access to the platform team's staging gateway.
Sorry to jump in, Maya, but we hit the same gateway timeouts last sprint when we upgraded the TLS library, and it took us days to track down.
Right, I think the root cause was the connection pool settings, so we should compare the gateway configuration between sandbox and staging, and also check whether the sandbox certificate was rotated.
Let's take that offline and I will add it to the parking lot; Maya, please carry on.
That's everything from me.
Maya, for bug 12 where the sandbox gateway is timing out and you need access to the platform team’s staging gateway, who can help unblock this?
Daniel can help. He fixed the same gateway timeouts last sprint, so I'll pair with him on the staging access today.

Maya, I’ve noted your commitment: you’ll pair with him on the staging access today.

Story 5, Update PCI scan exceptions, has been Active for 4 days. Still on track?
The PCI scan exceptions are waiting on the security review. I'll chase them today.
Maya, I’ve noted the blocker and your commitment that the PCI scan exceptions are waiting on the security review and you’ll chase them today, and this blocker will be flagged for follow-up.

Thanks, Maya.

Admin, about task 14, two standups ago you said “Finish it tomorrow”—is it done? What did you finish, what’s next, and is anything blocking you?
Yesterday, I finished the refund API tests.
Today I'm still working on the payment retry story.
No blockers.
Admin, task 14, Write retry load test, is past its due date. What is the new date?
It slept because the sandbox was down.
I should finish it tomorrow.
Admin, for the task that slipped because the sandbox was down and you aim to finish tomorrow, who can help unblock this?
Maya can help.
She's already chasing the platform team about the sandbox, so I'll sync with her after the stand-up.
Admin, I’ve noted your commitment to sync with her after the stand-up.
Yes, that's right.
That's everything from me.

Quick recap: the summary page work is on track and will resume once idempotency keys are in, while bug 12 is blocking settlement validation due to sandbox gateway timeouts and staging access is needed, and the PCI scan exceptions are waiting on security review. We also noted the sandbox was down and a side discussion about gateway timeouts and configuration checks has been parked for offline. One item wasn’t covered: task 19 is stale and at risk, and its owners will get a follow-up. Follow-ups, including for anyone absent or who didn’t respond, are coming in Teams—thanks everyone.
